styleSelection.reason: Loose ink and wash: dense oak canopies are below wash resolution and carry their structure in pen over mixed dark washes; sparse long pen lines open the sheet on path edges and grass boundaries.

HILLS.grass-top.reason: Open sunlit grass is a value plane with a crisp edge against the canopy, not a texture; one connected pale wash, then cast-shadow glazes.

HILLS.grass-wedge.reason: Open sunlit grass is a value plane with a crisp edge against the canopy.

HILLS.grass-band.reason: Narrow sunlit band: a wash plane with one crisp lower edge.

HILLS.grass-lower.reason: Largest light mass: one connected yellow-green wash, shadow glazes where oaks cast onto it.

HILLS.grass-lowleft.reason: Grass between path and forest: wash plane.

HILLS.path-left.reason: Pale dirt track kept as near-paper, crisp both sides.

HILLS.path-lower.reason: Pale dirt track kept as near-paper, crisp both sides.

HILLS.path-top.reason: Pale dirt track kept as near-paper, crisp both sides.
